title: Biomechanics/Motion Analysis Laboratory Data Bank
official: University of Florida Biomechanics/Motion Analysis Laboratory Data Bank
summary: The purpose of the data bank is to collect data on joint motion.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any person having joint analysis done for medical or personal need

Exclusion Criteria:

* None, any person having joint analysis done for medical or personal need and interested in participation will be asked to sign informed consent.

sites.f: UF Orthopaedics and Sports Medicine Institute
